scope: fresh D018 ID corpus; one frozen E11 diffusion checkpoint; no training

method.control: first four candidates from the identical 16-candidate pool
method.selection: hard-valid candidates first, then reference-free physics score and trajectory diversity
method.selection_inputs: visible frame zero, selected mask, force vector and generated poses
method.excluded_from_selection: reference futures, hidden physics and evaluation metrics

interpretation: Physics-guided test-time selection removed observed hull penetrations and reduced wall violations without reducing tracker coverage. The strict quality gate remains failed, so this is evidence for candidate selection rather than a promoted model.
limitations: one checkpoint and the D018 ID split only
16 candidates cost four times as many model samples as the four-future control
the selector checks necessary visible constraints, not full physical correctness
the selected ADE is a diagnostic against one realized hidden-physics reference

provenance.note: Hashes identify the measured snapshot; later changes were locked formatting and administrative renumbering from D031 to D036.
